title: Rawframe architecture conformance rule corpus
description: The maintained declarative set of checks rf-archcheck enforces. SPEC-0044 fixes the grammar. This document is reviewed source, not evidence and not generated output.

policyVersion.description: The monotonic integer pinning one revision of the rule set. It appears in every findings document so that a result names the rules that produced it.

ruleSetSeal.description: The integrity seal of the canonical form of `rules`. It is an FNV-1a 64 value and deliberately not a cryptographic digest: SPEC-0044 gives this tool no digest provider because it verifies nothing cryptographic. The seal exists so that a change to `rules` that does not increase `policyVersion` is mechanically visible, which is what RA1006 refuses.

policyHistory.description: One entry per policy version, in increasing order, ending with the current one. History makes a version increase observable rather than asserted.

id.description: The stable check identity. The digit after RA is the ADR-0077 check class. An id is never reused for a different meaning; a changed meaning takes a new id.

authority.description: Exactly one accepted document identifier. A rule that would need two authorities is two rules.

title.description: One sentence stating what the rule refuses, in the present tense. It carries no path, module name, or value specific to one repository state.

severity.description: One value, deliberately. ADR-0077 makes findings a blocking gate, and a second severity would be a way to land a violation while claiming the check passed.

landsWith.description: `now` where the rule has live subjects at the tool's own landing, otherwise the Task that creates its subjects. A rule that lands later is still implemented, tested, and enforced from the first commit.
